class.name: JRPGTermsData
class.brief_description: The words a JRPG uses for stats, commands and messages.
class.description: Holds four groups of terms: basic statuses, parameters, commands and messages. Each term has a name (for example [code]attack[/code]) and a text. Message texts can contain numbered placeholders such as [code]%1[/code]. Terms are translated through keys of the form [code]Terms.<group>.<name>[/code]; the texts stored here are used when no translation exists.

method.name: get_default_terms
method.description: Returns Talewright's default text for every term of [param group].

method.name: get_group
method.description: Returns the terms of [param group] as a [Dictionary] of name to text.

method.name: get_group_name
method.description: Returns the name of [param group], for example [code]"commands"[/code].

method.name: get_term
method.description: Returns the text of the term [param name] in [param group]. Terms the project has not set fall back to the default text; unknown names return an empty string.

method.name: get_translation_key
method.description: Returns the translation key of a term, for example [code]Terms.commands.attack[/code].

method.name: set_term
method.description: Sets the text of the term [param name] in [param group].
